proj-1.title: Video Journal Analyzer
proj-1.description: A web app for analyzing video URLs with two modes: diary entry analysis (emotions and moods) and rhetoric coach (speaking style, articulation, improvement suggestions).

proj-2.description: An audio tool for splitting songs into individual components such as drums, guitar, bass, vocals, and other instruments using AI-powered audio source separation.

exp-2.role: Working Student - AI Automation and E-Commerce
exp-2.impact:
I'm expanding a project from my internship into a complete full-stack application.

I develop API endpoints, connect them to the database, and design the frontend. The goal is to make the system more stable, scalable, and user-friendly.

Additionally, I support the automation of business processes using AI.

I support first-semester students in weekly courses for an optimal start to their studies.

Through tips, workshops, and personal advice, I help them navigate the university and study successfully.
